about.text: This case arises from a voter-approved City of Scottsdale transaction-privilege and use tax (“the Tax”) placed on the ballot as Proposition 490. Appellants Robert Stamper and Gretchen Jacobs, doing business as AZ Design Group, appeal from the superior court’s dismissal of their complaint seeking a declaration that the Tax did not receive the required supermajority approval to become law, as well as the court’s denial of their motion to enjoin the Tax’s enforcement.

caseName: Robert Marc Stamper v. City of Scottsdale
